calls.reason: OpenAI's $40B raise does show it relied on outside capital. But the only other evidence is a reported plan to reach positive cash flow by 2029, which neither proves nor rules out a workable path to profit.

Gamma, which builds on others' models, called itself profitable in a July 3, 2025 interview, before the post. An April report said the same. That breaks the blanket 'every single' claim, though Gamma's accounts are unaudited.

JCR kept SoftBank's A rating while moving its outlook to negative. SoftBank's own filings show leverage near 20% after the OpenAI payment and enough cash to cover two years of bond redemptions. That is strain, not dire straits.

This is an opinion with no clear test. The Bank of England saw stretched valuations, but First Trust found the big tech stocks' P/E barely moved. Neither shows a weak bubble with a single point of failure.

Epoch AI, an independent source, estimated that Microsoft and Amazon together earn more selling access to others' models than the top AI labs earn. Microsoft alone had a $13B AI run rate. Both suggest OpenAI and Anthropic were under half of industry revenue.

This is a rhetorical claim about what NVIDIA's value depends on. The packet has only NVIDIA's sequential revenue growth, with no GPU unit counts and no analysis showing growth every quarter is required.
